description:
Congratulations to Marc Márquez on the 2026 MotoGP World Championship!

This title is the comeback story of the decade: mid-season he sat 102 points adrift — the largest deficit ever overcome in the premier class. Yet he never stopped believing. Seven wins, calm under fire, and a refusal to accept limits. His eighth premier-class crown. The reign continues.

At Insta360, we're proud to partner with a rider who lives with a "Think bold" mindset — and prouder still to have captured it all on the Insta360 X6, from a vantage point no one else could reach.
Congratulations once more, Marc. Here's to champions who keep rewriting the rules. 🏁
